capabilities: search the open Eagle library and embed images with their metadata
import pasted or dropped images into a chosen Eagle library and folder
choose between six link modes for embedded assets
upload images to configured cloud providers
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.6.6+); README warns that migration commands can rewrite other notes and trash vault originals, and that cloud uploads disclose image bytes to the provider; the full manual is hosted externally (English, Korean, and web versions).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search an Eagle library or control whether embedded images link to local originals, portable previews, or cloud URLs.

relations.evidence: Search the open Eagle library and embed an image with its metadata.
Upload images to cloud storage (ImgHippo, R2, S3, WebDAV).

requires.name: cloud storage provider (ImgHippo, R2, S3, or WebDAV)

summary: Integration that connects an Eagle asset library to a vault for searching, embedding, importing, and cloud-uploading image assets.
